Zamanand

Munich · Odeonsplatz stage

Zamanand is Bavarian for “together”, and for a weekend in September Ludwigstraße became one long free street festival, from Odeonsplatz up to the Siegestor. We played the Odeonsplatz stage after dark, right in the middle of the city.
